title: Health and Sport

story.title: Shahzod’s healthy year
story.text: Last winter, Shahzod was often ill. He had **a cold** almost every month, he often had **a headache**, and once he had **a temperature** for three days. He took a lot of **medicine**. He decided to **see a doctor**. The doctor asked him some questions. “How much do you sleep? Do you do any sport?” Shahzod said, “I sleep five hours, and I’m a bit **lazy** – I never go to the **gym**.” | The doctor said, “You need to **get enough sleep**, **drink** more **water** and be more **active**.” | So Shahzod changed his life. Now he **goes running** three times a week and he **goes swimming** on Saturdays. He also joined a football **team**. Last week they played an important **match**, and they **won**! | He doesn’t eat much junk food now, and he **lost** five kilos of **weight**. He has less **stress** and he hardly ever **feels sick**. “I’m **in** really **good shape** now,” he says. “It’s easy to **keep fit** – you just need to start!”

answers: What do you do to keep fit?
**I try to keep fit by** walking a lot and playing football. **I go** to the **gym twice a week**. **For example**, yesterday I walked ten thousand steps!
What advice can you give to a lazy friend?
**You should** start with something easy, like a short walk every day. **You shouldn’t** sit at the computer all day. And find a friend to do sport with – it’s more fun!
speech: Hi everyone! I want to talk about health and sport. **I’m not very sporty, but** I try to be active. **I try to keep fit by** swimming and walking. **I go** swimming **twice a week** after school. I also try to **drink** a lot of **water** and **get enough sleep** – at least eight hours. **When I’m stressed, I** go for a long walk or listen to music. Last month I had a bad cold, and I stayed at home for a week. It was terrible! **I think the secret of good health is** sleep, sport and good food. Thank you!
